questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quem governou o Brasil durante o Segundo Reinado?
questions.hint: Foi o último imperador do Brasil.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual produto foi o principal item de exportação do Brasil no Segundo Reinado?
questions.hint: É uma bebida muito consumida até hoje.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que região o café se expandiu primeiro, no início do Segundo Reinado?
questions.hint: Fica entre o Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo, ao longo de um rio.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual era a principal mão de obra nas fazendas de café do Vale do Paraíba?
questions.hint: Pense em quem trabalhava à força nas fazendas antes de 1888.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que a produção de café no Vale do Paraíba entrou em declínio?
options: Esgotamento do solo e falta de novas terras
Fim do comércio com outros países
questions.answer: Esgotamento do solo e falta de novas terras
questions.hint: Pense no que acontece com a terra depois de muitos anos de cultivo sem cuidado.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como eram chamados os grandes fazendeiros de café do Vale do Paraíba, que recebiam títulos de nobreza?
questions.hint: O título de nobreza aparece no próprio nome.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Que tipo de solo favoreceu o café no Oeste Paulista?
questions.hint: O nome lembra uma cor.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Que mão de obra os cafeicultores do Oeste Paulista passaram a usar cada vez mais no fim do século XIX?
questions.hint: Muitos vieram da Itália.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual lei de 1850 proibiu o tráfico de africanos escravizados para o Brasil?
questions.hint: Leva o nome de um ministro da época.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual meio de transporte foi construído para levar o café do interior até o porto de Santos?
questions.hint: Usava locomotivas a vapor.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual foi o principal porto de exportação do café do Oeste Paulista?
questions.hint: Fica no litoral de São Paulo.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual afirmação compara corretamente as duas regiões cafeeiras?
options: O Oeste Paulista usou mais imigrantes e técnicas modernas; o Vale do Paraíba dependeu da escravidão.
O Vale do Paraíba usou só imigrantes; o Oeste Paulista usou só escravizados.
As duas regiões não usaram ferrovias.
O Vale do Paraíba cresceu depois do Oeste Paulista.
questions.answer: O Oeste Paulista usou mais imigrantes e técnicas modernas; o Vale do Paraíba dependeu da escravidão.
questions.hint: Pense em qual região era mais antiga e em qual era mais nova.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Que efeito o dinheiro do café teve na cidade de São Paulo?
questions.hint: Os lucros precisavam ser investidos em algum lugar.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que ano terminou o Segundo Reinado, com a Proclamação da República?
questions.hint: Foi um ano depois da Lei Áurea.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique por que a cafeicultura do Oeste Paulista foi considerada mais moderna que a do Vale do Paraíba.
questions.hint: Pense em mão de obra, transporte e técnicas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Analise como o fim do tráfico de escravizados, em 1850, afetou os fazendeiros de café.
questions.hint: O que acontece quando falta trabalhador e o café continua crescendo?

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: In object-oriented programming, what is a class?
questions.hint: Think of a plan or template.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is an object?
options: An instance created from a class
questions.answer: An instance created from a class
questions.hint: It is made using the class as a template.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Which keyword is used to define a class in Python?
questions.hint: It is the same as the name of the concept.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: In a class called Dog, which of these would be an attribute?
questions.hint: Attributes store data; methods do actions.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: In a class called Dog, which of these would be a method?
questions.hint: Methods are actions, written like functions.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What is the name of the special Python method that runs automatically when a new object is created?
questions.hint: It has two underscores on each side.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: What does 'self' refer to inside a method?
options: The object the method is called on
questions.answer: The object the method is called on
questions.hint: It means 'this particular one'.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Given class Cat with __init__(self, name), which line correctly creates an object?
questions.hint: Call the class like a function.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: How do you access the attribute 'name' of an object called my_cat?
questions.hint: Python uses dot notation.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Inside __init__, which line stores the parameter 'speed' as an attribute?
questions.hint: The attribute belongs to self.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: A class Car is used to create three objects: car1, car2 and car3. How many classes are there?
questions.hint: One blueprint can make many objects.

questions.subject: comp
questions.hint: Start at 0 and count how many times add() runs.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Why is the first parameter of every method in a Python class usually 'self'?
options: So the method can access the object's own attributes
Because Python needs it to print text
To make the method run faster
questions.answer: So the method can access the object's own attributes
questions.hint: Each object has its own data.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Two objects, a = Box(5) and b = Box(9), are created from the same class. Which statement is true?
options: They can have different attribute values
They must have the same attribute values
questions.answer: They can have different attribute values
questions.hint: Each instance stores its own data.

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Write a Python class called Student with attributes name and year, and a method greet() that prints a greeting using the student's name.
questions.hint: Start with class Student: and define __init__(self, name, year).

questions.subject: comp
questions.q: Explain one advantage of using classes and objects when writing a game with many characters.
questions.hint: Think about reusing the same blueprint many times.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the main purpose of a formal report?
options: To present information and findings clearly to a specific audience
To describe a holiday to a friend
questions.answer: To present information and findings clearly to a specific audience
questions.hint: Reports inform before they recommend.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is a proposal?
options: A document that suggests a plan and argues for it
questions.answer: A document that suggests a plan and argues for it
questions.hint: It proposes something new.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which feature is typical of a formal report?
questions.hint: Think of how a report is divided into sections.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence is most suitable for a formal report?
options: The survey indicates that most students prefer a longer lunch break.
Loads of kids want a longer lunch, obviously!
Lunch is way too short, to be honest.
questions.answer: The survey indicates that most students prefer a longer lunch break.
questions.hint: Look for impersonal, precise language.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which section usually comes first in a formal report?
questions.hint: It explains the purpose of the report.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: What is the name of the section where a report suggests what should be done next?
questions.hint: It comes from the verb 'recommend'.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which phrase is best for making a formal recommendation?
options: It is recommended that the library opens earlier.
The library should totally open earlier!
Why don't they just open the library earlier?
I reckon the library is rubbish.
questions.answer: It is recommended that the library opens earlier.
questions.hint: Formal writing often uses the passive voice.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Why do formal reports often use the passive voice, e.g. 'Data was collected'?
options: To sound impersonal and focus on the action
questions.answer: To sound impersonal and focus on the action
questions.hint: Who did it matters less than what was done.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which is the most formal replacement for 'a lot of'?
questions.hint: Avoid informal words.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In a report on the school canteen, which section would contain the survey results?
questions.hint: This section says what was found out.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which connective is best for adding a further point in a formal report?
questions.hint: Choose the most formal option.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: A proposal for a new school garden should mainly…
options: explain the plan, its benefits and its costs
tell a story about a garden
list every plant in the world
questions.answer: explain the plan, its benefits and its costs
questions.hint: The reader needs to decide whether to approve it.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which recommendation is the most specific and useful?
options: Two extra water fountains should be installed near the sports hall by next term.
Someone should do something about water.
questions.answer: Two extra water fountains should be installed near the sports hall by next term.
questions.hint: Good recommendations say what, where and when.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence would make a strong conclusion to a formal report?
options: In conclusion, the evidence suggests that a longer break would improve students' concentration.
That's all I have to say, bye!
Also, I forgot to mention the canteen.
questions.answer: In conclusion, the evidence suggests that a longer break would improve students' concentration.
questions.hint: A conclusion draws the findings together.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Rewrite this informal sentence in a formal style suitable for a report: 'Loads of students reckon the buses are always late and it's really annoying.'
questions.hint: Replace slang and remove personal feelings.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: You are writing a proposal to the head teacher for a new after-school club. Write two recommendations, each with a reason.
questions.hint: Use 'It is recommended that…' and 'This would…'.
